Lesson 8. Eighth-Note and Eighth-Rest Placement

When a beat is subdivided into an eighth note and a rest, the subdivided beat should be completed with an eighth note or rest before the next beat begins. Quarter rests and half rests should always begin on the beat, never on the “and” of a beat. The incorrect example below shows a quarter rest that begins on the “and” of a beat. In the correct version, the first eighth rest completes beat 1 and the second eighth rest begins on beat 2. Incorrect Correct

In the next example, the incorrect measure shows a quarter rest that begins on the “and” of beat 3. To correct this, the quarter rest is shifted to represent beat 3, and the eighth rest and note together complete beat 4. Incorrect Correct

Practice

1. Complete each incomplete measure with rest values. Be careful to complete each subdivided beat before beginning the next one.

Eighth-Note and Eighth-Rest Placement

When a beat is subdivided into an eighth note and a rest, the subdivided beat should be completed with an eighth note or rest before the next beat begins.
Quarter rests and half rests should always begin on the beat, never on the “and” of a beat.
The incorrect example below shows a quarter rest that begins on the “and” of a beat.
In the correct version, the first eighth rest completes beat 1 and the second eighth rest begins on beat 2.

Incorrect Correct

In the next example, the incorrect measure shows a quarter rest that begins on the “and” of beat 3.
To correct this, the quarter rest is shifted to represent beat 3, and the eighth rest and note together complete beat 4.
Complete each incomplete measure with rest values.
Be careful to complete each subdivided beat before beginning the next one.
